scope: Actual CMSIS queue creation/send/get/count/capacity, static/dynamic native queues, task/ISR send/receive, kernel query/critical, priority validator, native heap and movement; fill/full/empty/two-ring-round lifetimes and reclamation
limitations: Controlled prekernel nonblocking queues have no waiters. IRQ/mask/MMIO values are fixtures; actual interrupt dispatch and blocking scheduling do not execute. Only authenticated heap caller LR is normalized. No hardware or image instruction equality proof.
